blocks.text: GUANGDONG — The shared history of overseas Chinese in the Philippines and the evolution of Filipino-Chinese trade, cultural ties, and friendship were highlighted in the exhibit “Worlds That Meet: The Tsinoy Experience in the Philippines.” Located at the Wuyi Overseas Chinese Square Exhibition Center at the Jiangmen Museum in Jiangmen City, Guangdong Province in China, the exhibit formally opened on (Nov. 21, 2026), led by the Philippine Consulate General in Guangzhou and Jiangmen Foreign Affairs Bureau. The exhibition was organized by Bahay Tsinoy (Museum of Chinese in Philippine Life) and Kaisa Heritage Foundation, in partnership with the Jiangmen Museum. The term […]...
